question: What inbound QQ gateway message ceiling should the plugin support without rejecting valid events?
rationale: The repository and ws dependency define the enforcement mechanism, but only QQBot domain ownership or an official QQ contract can safely choose the compatibility ceiling.

options.title: Require a contract-backed ceiling
options.body: Block merge until the constant is derived from official QQ limits or representative production measurements and is covered by normal-delivery and reconnect proof.

options.title: Accept 1 MiB explicitly
options.body: A QQBot owner may intentionally accept the lower compatibility ceiling after confirming valid gateway events cannot exceed it and reviewing real-environment proof.

recommendation.title: Require a contract-backed ceiling
recommendation.body: Block merge until the constant is derived from official QQ limits or representative production measurements and is covered by normal-delivery and reconnect proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their major gateway refactor is the strongest available feature-history connection to QQBot event framing and reconnect behavior.
